name: dataiku-standard-webapp
description: Build, patch, deploy, and visually validate native Dataiku Standard WebApps using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and optional Python backends.

interface.longDescription: A reusable workflow for building, patching, deploying, and visually validating native Dataiku Standard WebApps. Includes architecture, design, deployment, QA guidance, starter templates, and helper scripts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use this plugin to build or patch a native Dataiku Standard WebApp.
